note: Eighteen questions in plain words. Each one is tied to the family of prongs it touches, and each carries the documents an auditor would expect to see behind the answer. The tool records the answer and lists the documents. It never scores, ranks or concludes.

prong_families.control: Control over how the work is done
prong_families.business: Whether the work sits inside your usual business
prong_families.independent: Whether the worker has a business of their own

questions.ask: Who decides the days and hours the work happens?
options: We set a window, the worker picks inside it
documents: Any schedule, rota or shift message you sent
The written agreement clause on hours

questions.ask: Who decides the method — the actual steps used to do the job?
options: We give a spec, the worker picks the method
documents: Your written spec, brief or standard operating procedure
Emails or chat where the method was set

questions.ask: Does anyone at your firm supervise or review the work while it is in progress?
options: Only the finished result is checked
documents: Supervisor notes, check-in calendar invites
Quality review or sign-off records

questions.ask: Did you train the worker in how you want the work done?
options: Only an induction on site rules or safety
documents: Training materials, induction pack, attendance record
Site or access records
The agreement clause on place of work

questions.ask: Who supplies the tools, equipment and materials?
documents: Invoices or receipts for the worker's own equipment
Your asset register or loan form

questions.ask: Is the work the same thing your business sells to its own customers?
documents: Your marketing pages and customer contracts describing what you sell
The scope of work in the agreement

questions.ask: Do your own employees do this same work?
documents: Job descriptions for employees doing similar work
Payroll records

questions.ask: Is the work a step inside your normal production or service line?
options: No, it is a separate service we buy in
Yes, it is a step in what we deliver
documents: A process or workflow diagram
The customer-facing delivery description

questions.ask: Does the worker have a registered business of their own?
documents: Business registration or incorporation certificate
Business tax filings

questions.ask: Does the worker do this work for other customers too?
documents: Invoices the worker issued to other customers
The worker's own website or advertising

questions.ask: Does the worker advertise the service to the public?
documents: Website, listing, van livery, business cards, ad receipts

questions.ask: Does the worker hold their own licence, permit or insurance for this work?
documents: Licence or permit certificate
Certificate of insurance

questions.ask: Can the worker make more or less money by managing the job well or badly?
options: Yes, the worker carries the profit and the loss
No, the pay is the same either way
documents: Fixed-price quotes the worker issued
Records of a job the worker lost money on

questions.ask: Has the worker spent their own money on equipment or premises for this work?
documents: Purchase invoices, lease or finance agreements

options: Per job or per deliverable, against their invoice
By the hour, day or week
documents: The worker's invoices
Your payment ledger entries

questions.ask: How long has the arrangement run, or how long is it expected to run?
options: A defined project with an end
documents: The signed agreement with dates
Renewal or extension emails

questions.ask: Is there a signed written agreement, and does it name the parties' intent?
documents: The agreement itself, signature page included
